text:
Landing at Kansai Airport with a Kyoto hotel? The Haruka gets you there in about 75–80 minutes with no change, and visitors pay ¥2,700. But there's one landing time when the bus is the only smart choice 👇

🎯 Bet you can guess which landing time, before you check 👉 https://japanbystation.com/kansai-airport-to-kyoto

We checked every fare and timetable against JR West, the airport and the bus company.

🚄 A · JR HARUKA

About every 30 minutes, last train from the airport 22:16. The HARUKA One-way Ticket for foreign visitors is ¥2,700 to Kyoto if bought from 1 November 2026; the regular unreserved fare is about ¥3,100.

🚌 B · LIMOUSINE BUS

¥2,800, about 85–90 minutes to Kyoto Station's Hachijo Exit, roughly every 20 minutes. Suitcases go in the hold, and the last bus leaves Terminal 1 at 23:20, more than an hour after the last Haruka.

🚃 C · ORDINARY TRAINS VIA OSAKA

The cheapest: Nankai, the subway and the Hankyu line to Kawaramachi for about ¥1,670, about 1 hour 50 minutes. Fine with a backpack, hard with two suitcases.

💭 OUR TAKE

Haruka for most people. Bus if you land late or your hotel is on the south side of Kyoto Station. Hankyu if you're travelling light to a hotel on Shijo.
